about_item: 【Large Capacity LR44 Battery】Each fairy lights is equipped with 3 pre installed 180mAh batteries, which can provide up to 72 hours of lighting without additional purchase. Very suitable for decorating mason jars, vases, handicrafts, bottles, plants, decorations, flower wreaths, flower wreaths, etc

【Value 24 Pack】Made of high-quality 7-foot silver wire, soft and durable, easy to wrap around anything. Equipped with 20 LED mini lights that emit soft 3000k warm lights, it looks like a fairyland and creates a comfortable and romantic atmosphere

【3 lighting modes】Fairy flashing lights provides: fast flashing, slow flashing, and continuous lighting. Each one provides unique decorative effects and atmosphere to meet your various occasion needs. There is a button switch on the side design for opening/closing and switching modes

【IP65 Waterproof & Safe Use】The fairy string lights supports IP65 waterproof and can be submerged in water (the battery box is not waterproof). Powered by a safe 1.5V low voltage, it will not generate heat or short circuit even after prolonged use, ensuring safe touch and use

【Wonderful Decorative Lighting】Including 24 packs of fairy lights and a screwdriver for battery replacement. Creating a magical, charming, and gentle atmosphere is an ideal choice for meaningful holiday decorations such as weddings, birthdays, parties, Christmas, Thanksgiving, etc

summary.text: Customers find these string lights to be of good quality and appreciate their appearance, particularly how they look in decorated jars for holidays. The lights work well for various projects, including centerpieces and mantles, and customers consider them good value for money. However, the battery life and brightness receive mixed reviews - while they are bright initially, they become dim within hours, and customers report that batteries don't last very long. Moreover, durability is a concern as some units died within half an hour of use.

insights.title: Versatility
